title: Test complete-operation fit after CCA deferral
description:
Scope: full-operation and deferral cases in the admission supplement under /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/. Specify setup/retune/CCA, complete PHY emission, explicitly reserved turnaround/response and one trailing guard relative to protected RX/control boundaries. Independently recompute remaining operation time and legal/adaptive budgets after deferral. Use the frozen resource/airtime/ledger oracles. Do not assume instantaneous retune, introduce a universal ACK, grant free response airtime or count non-emitting guard/listen time as a second transmission.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Specify one verifiable complete-operation contract using existing arithmetic anchors. SCHC/CoAP responses require their own valid opportunities unless the exact wire contract explicitly reserves the full exchange.
acceptance_criteria: Exact-fit, one-unit-late, insufficient-setup-slack and response-without-opportunity cases have independent expected rejection/admission. CCA deferral can invalidate a formerly eligible operation and must trigger fresh time/budget checks; exhaustion does not select SF12. Occupation and emitted-airtime ledgers remain separate, with a single guard and complete frame costs. Cases preserve receiver commitments and appear in the supplement inventory for actual driver-boundary tests.
